verdict.rationale: The only delegation evidence is that sponsored support staff can prepare and save an AIR Form, which Corresponding Practitioners can then access. That shows a published role split between support staff and practitioners in Patent Center, but it is a single thin mention. missing for 10: published authorization/power-of-attorney forms, a full catalogue of delegate roles and their permitted actions, explicit rules on which signatures or certifications must remain personal, coverage beyond Patent Center (e.g., Trademark Center), independent corroboration.
